visual.description: Two-phase scene. Phase 1: Counter ticks from 0 to 8,000 ('synthetic chemicals') in JetBrains Mono, glass surface card. Below: '150+ classified as hazardous' in Accent Pink with blur-fade-in. Phase 2: Text swap — glitch text effect reveals 'eco-friendly ≠ safe' in Montserrat Bold, center screen. The ≠ symbol pulses in Negative Red (#E06070).

notes: Two-phase counter scene. Phase 1 runs ~8s (counter + subtitle), Phase 2 runs ~7s (glitch text reveal). The glitch-text for 'eco-friendly ≠ safe' creates a jarring digital effect that underscores the paradox. Use composite-phases if implementation needs two distinct visual phases.
